title: The Cosmic Web
description: On the largest scales the galaxies are not scattered evenly: they lie along filaments and sheets round enormous voids, the shape gravity has pulled the dark matter into since the Big Bang. Unlocks the cosmic web simulation.

puzzle.goal: For the Universe to be exactly flat, the mass in each cubic metre must balance its expansion rate H against gravity's constant G. Write how much mass ρ each cubic metre must hold.
puzzle.name: Critical density
puzzle.ask: Find ρ in protons per cubic metre for H = @{H} /s (70 km/s/Mpc), G = 6.674e-11 and a proton mass m = 1.6726e-27 kg.
puzzle.method: Friedmann's equation, H² = 8πGρ/3 − k/a², with the curvature k set to zero.
